items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: And the whole band -- Duke has a few lines in it, and the whole band got a lot of film space -- Toby, Harry, Johnny, Barney, Freddie Jenkins, Cootie, Arthur Whetsol, Tricky Sam, and you, Lawrence...

ctx.x: So there wasn't any big secret about it? Somebody -- I think it was either Herbie Jones or Jimmie Jones, who said that Duke had his own kind of musical shorthand; almost like a code that he wrote in -- that somebody who didn't know him or didn't work with him, wouldn't understand what he wanted.

Well, I don't know. I remember one time I heard him say -- he sat down at the piano, and he said if that sounds good to him, he's gonna write it -- I don't care even if the harmony was wrong. He would write whatever he thinks is gonna sound all right to him. And his chords, and That is why he got away, on account of the way the band sounded many times, because he was writing for Like Tricky Sam -- who could write for Tricky Sam? the musicians in the way they played their horns. That's the way he did it. Oh, he…
I know ... somebody said in a rehearsal, "Oh, I played that wrong", and Duke said, "Don't change it -- the mistakes are the best part!"

items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Personnel -- ... Tricky Sam Nanton, Juan Tizol ... Ellington -- piano.

ctx.x: they laugh at jokes that don't mean anything. And the same thing at that time, too.

There is also a listing here for "Bundle of Blues," 1938. It was "an eight minute short; a Paramount musical short featuring Duke Ellington and his orchestra with 'Rocking and Rhythm,' a vocal rendering of 'Stormy Weather' by Ivy Anderson and a tap dance routine from Florence Mills and Bessie Dudley to 'Bugle Call Rag.'" "Personnel -- Marshall Royal, Harry Carney, Barney Bigard, Johnny Hodges, Tricky Sam Nanton, Juan Tizol, Lawrence Brown, trombones; Cootie Williams, Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Jenkins, trumpets;…
Do you remember making a short subject with Florence Mills and Bessie Dudley? For Paramount?
